stories.title: Wiki article generation crashes on a matching ticket

agent.summary: Fixed generateWikiArticle throwing for strings matching a knowledge-base article by searching the wiki directly (draftReply doesn't return the article), and added tests for both matching and non-matching string inputs.

turns.assistantText: Let me reproduce the issue to see the actual error.

Now I understand the bug. `draftReply` returns `wiki: { found, key }` without the `article`, so `generateWikiArticle` accesses `r.wiki.article.title` — which is `undefined.title` and throws when the string matches an article. The fix is to search the wiki directly for the article data while keeping the rest of the no-match output identical.

turns.assistantText:
All 144 tests pass (142 original + 2 new). The fix is complete and minimal.

**Root cause:** In `generateWikiArticle`, the string branch called `draftReply({ text: input })`, but `draftReply` returns `wiki: { found, key }` — it does **not** include the `article` in the returned `wiki` object. So when a string matched a knowledge-base article, `r.wiki.article.title` threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'title')`. The no-match path never accessed `r.wiki.article`, which is why only matching strings blew up.

**Fix:** In the string branch, call `searchWiki(input)` directly (the same search `draftReply` uses internally) to obtain the matched article, then use `wiki.article.title` / `wiki.article.body` as required. The no-match output is byte-for-byte what it was before (title `New issue resolved`, same cause/resolution placeholders).

**Tests added** in `test/support.test.js`:
- Matching string → title `<article title> (resolved)`, root cause is article title, resolution is article body.
- Non-matching string → keeps `New issue resolved` and the existing fallback text.

## Summary

In `src/core/e96.js` (the resistor-series module):
- Added `E24`, a frozen array with the 24 standard E24 mantissas in ascending order.
- Added `nearestE24(valueOhm)`, which behaves exactly like `nearestE96` (same `{ valueOhm, errorPct }` return shape and validation) but picks from the E24 series. Implementation was refactored by extracting the shared logic into a private `nearestInSerie(valueOhm, serie, nombre)` helper so both functions use identical behavior.
- Updated the module docstring to mention both series.

In `test/e96.test.js`, added tests covering:
- `E24` contents, ordering, length, and mantissa range.
- `nearestE24` returns exact values for the whole series across decades.
- `nearestE24` rounding and error reporting, decade-boundary crossing (9.9 kΩ → 10 kΩ), and rejection of non-positive/non-finite inputs.
- `nearestE24` choosing between E24 neighbor values the same way `nearestE96` does.

Since `src/core/index.js` re-exports everything from `e96.js` via `export *`, `E24` and `nearestE24` are also available through the core public API.

## Summary

I modified `findGain` in `src/core/spec.js` to support gains expressed in decibels in free text:
